en: Kvissentali: three years, the same ground.
Half a kilo. The shopkeeper was surprised.
A black bird, heavy as a stone.

et: Üks jänes. Kubjas ei tohi teada.
en: One hare. The steward must not know.

et: Vana kirjaviis. Nimi esilehel: Kaseoja Mart, kirjutatud kellegi teise käega.
en: Old orthography. A name on the flyleaf: Kaseoja Mart, in someone else's hand.
The dairy cooperative's number is stamped on it.

et: Paberisse keeratud. Juhan loeb need üle.
en: Wrapped in paper. Juhan will count them.
A basket of potatoes, soil still on them.

et: Kellegi sirp. Terast on vähe alles.
en: Someone's sickle. Not much steel left.

et: Vihk. Leib on selle sees kuskil.
en: A sheaf. Bread is in there somewhere.

et: Kotike soola. Kallim kui kõik muu.
en: A bag of salt. Dearer than anything else.
In a paper packet, from the shop.
For horses and people, in that order.
Roe deer meat, wrapped in cloth.

et: Kahele lehmale ja hobusele, kui hobune tuleb.
en: For two cows and a horse, if the horse comes.

et: Pargi väravas. Ühingu auto peatub siin.
en: At the park gate. The cooperative's lorry stops here.
For the grain. Everything starts with a storehouse.

et: Lehekülg vanast raamatust: talu nimi, piirid, aasta 1798.
en: A page from an old book: a farm's name, its bounds, the year 1798.

et: Sa näitasid lehekülge sellele, kes raamatut pidas.
en: You showed the page to the one who kept the book.

et: Piir kirjutati üles. Hilisematel aastatel seisab põllu serval värav.
en: The boundary was written down. In the later years a gate stands at the field's edge.

et: Värav ilma aiata. Piir, mida keegi enam ei vaidlusta.
en: A gate without a fence. A boundary nobody disputes any more.

et: Põllu serv. Siin vaieldi kord piiri üle.
en: The edge of a field. A boundary was once argued over here.
"To whoever finds this. From the first harvest."

et: Sa andsid kirja sellele, kellele see mõeldud oli.
en: You gave the letter to the one it was meant for.

et: Kiri jõudis kohale. Ta teab nüüd, kus kast on.
en: The letter arrived. They know where the box is now.

et: Sa aitasid kaevu lahti hoida aastal 1798.
en: You helped keep the well open in 1798.

et: Kaev jäi. Hilisematel aastatel on talul oma vesi.
en: The well stayed. In the later years the farm has its own water.

et: Pooleli kaev. Käsk on see täis ajada. Keegi ei taha.
en: A half-dug well. The order is to fill it in. Nobody wants to.

et: Kiviring. Vesi on all, külm ja magus.
en: A ring of stones. The water is down there, cold and sweet.

et: Lohk maapinnas. Siin oli kord kaev.
en: A dip in the ground. There was a well here once.

et: Vana vasktükk, millesse on raiutud nimi ja aasta 1798.
en: An old piece of copper with a name and the year 1798 cut into it.

et: Mälestusese jõudis koju. Hilisematel aastatel seisab maamärgi juures kivi.
en: The keepsake came home. In the later years a stone stands by the landmark.

et: Kivi, mille keegi siia pani. Nimi on veel loetav.
en: A stone somebody set here. The name is still legible.

et: Raske raudkeel ilma kellata. Keegi teisest majast peab selle viima.
en: A heavy iron clapper without its bell. Somebody from another house must carry it.
A visitor from another world brought the clapper.

et: Kell riputati üles. Hilisematel aastatel seisab poe juures kellapost.
en: The bell was hung. In the later years a bell post stands by the shop.

et: Kellapost. Keel on teisest kohast, öeldakse. Heli on ikka omal.
en: A bell post. The clapper is from elsewhere, they say. The sound is its own.

et: Kimp õunapuuoksi, vahaga kaetud otsad. Ootavad maad.
en: A bundle of apple scions, ends sealed with wax. Waiting for ground.

et: Sa tõid pookoksad aastasse, kus keegi need istutas.
en: You brought the grafting stock to a year where somebody planted it.

et: Õunaaed kasvas. Hilisematel aastatel kannavad puud veel.
en: The orchard grew. In the later years the trees still bear.
Old apple trees. A few still bear.

et: Võsa. Kunagi taheti siia midagi istutada.
en: Scrub. Somebody once meant to plant something here.

et: Vii see, mille leidsid, sinna, kuhu see kuulub.
en: Take what you found to where it belongs.

et: Mine tagasi aastasse 2026 ja räägi lõpuni.
en: Go back to 2026 and finish the conversation.

et: Kõik, mis sai hoitud, on alles. Kast on kõige vanema puu all, ja selles on kolme põlve paberid.
en: Everything that could be kept is here. The box is under the oldest tree, and in it are three generations of papers.

et: Jäljed on alles. Mitte kõik, aga need, mis on, näitab Kadri sulle ükshaaval, kepiga.
en: Traces remain. Not all of them, but the ones that are, Kadri shows you one by one, with a stick.

et: Maa võttis suurema osa vaikselt tagasi. Lood räägitakse ikkagi, tamme juurel istudes.
en: The land quietly took most of it back. The stories are told anyway, sitting on the oak's roots.

et: Kastis on kiri ja pressitud õis, aga pabereid ei ole. „Noh. See oli see osa, mis loeb.“
en: The box holds the letter and a pressed blossom, but no papers. "Well. That was the part that mattered."
A book between the years. Take it.

et: Vakuraamat. Ava see (Tab) ja vali lehekülg.
en: The register. Open it (Tab) and choose a page.

et: Maa: Kvissentali, Maa- ja Ruumiameti kõrgusandmed, ortofoto ja ajaloolised kaardid, meetri täpsusega.
en: The ground: Kvissentali, from the Land Board's elevation data, orthophoto and historical maps, to the metre.

et: Inimesed, nende nimed ja lugu on kokku pandud lugude klotsidest; ükski neist ei kujuta päris inimest.
en: The people, their names and the story are assembled from story blocks; none depicts a real person.

en: Buying and selling for this year's money.
